scope: Hand-authored offline adversarial fixtures adapted from existing paired mocks; never provider generations. Same corpus replayed for V2 and compact; not evidence of creative superiority.

raw.title: Same-rule hammer control
raw.normalExpectation: Hammering a nail drives it straight into wall.
raw.impossibleRule: Every hammer strike causes the nail to bend away from the wall at a right angle; bending increases with force.
raw.visibleTrigger: Kiko hits nail; it curves 90 degrees without entering wall.
raw.whyThisObject: Hammer is meant to apply axial force to nail; if nail deflects under any force, it cannot penetrate.
raw.goalRuleRelationship: The action to hang frame fails as nail never goes straight, preventing secure mounting.
raw.frameZeroDescription: Kiko holds hammer mid-swing, but the nail protruding from the wall is bent into a U-shape, and the picture frame leans beside him.

beats.strategy: Kiko strikes the nail gently to hang the picture frame.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends away from the wall; the picture frame drops to the floor.
beats.newInformation: A gentle hammer strike still bends the nail and blocks hanging.

beats.strategy: Kiko turns sideways and strikes the same nail from the other side.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends away from the wall again; the picture frame slides farther down.
beats.newInformation: Changing the strike angle changes the hanging position but cannot seat the nail.

beats.strategy: Kiko moves the picture frame below the curved nail and strikes down.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hammer straightens the nail and drives it into the wall.
beats.newInformation: The nail straightens under the same hammer strike.

beats.strategy: Kiko places the picture frame on the shelf and gives the nail a final gentle strike.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends away from the wall above the picture frame, leaving it standing on the shelf instead of hanging.
beats.newInformation: The picture frame is displayed on the shelf while the bent nail points over it.

raw.finalPayoff: The nail bends away from the wall above the picture frame, leaving it standing on the shelf instead of hanging.
raw.providerRationale: The hammer drives force into a nail; the same bending response defeats each placement.

raw.title: Tangling Hairbrush
raw.normalExpectation: Brushing untangles hair and smooths it.
raw.impossibleRule: Each brush stroke creates a new knot, and the knots tighten the more you brush; hair eventually coils around the brush like a topiary.
raw.visibleTrigger: Opa brushes once, hair stands up in a giant knot.
raw.whyThisObject: Brush bristles are meant to separate strands; if they weave strands together, brushing becomes tangling.
raw.goalRuleRelationship: The action of brushing makes hair worse, so smooth hair is impossible.
raw.frameZeroDescription: Opa stands in front of mirror holding a brush, but his hair is a twisted bird's nest with the brush embedded in it.

beats.strategy: Opa pulls the brush out slowly, hoping to unwind the knot.
beats.visibleConsequence: The knot tightens into a bun that pulls his head back.
beats.newInformation: Pulling the brush out causes the hair to cinch, not loosen.

beats.strategy: Opa uses a wide-tooth comb to gently work through the tangle.
beats.visibleConsequence: The comb adds more knots, and his hair expands into a giant sphere around his head.
beats.newInformation: Any grooming tool multiplies knots instead of removing them.

beats.strategy: Opa applies hair conditioner to make strands slippery.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hair becomes like rubber, and the brush bounces off, but the knots stretch and snap back with more loops.
beats.newInformation: Conditioner turns hair elastic, making tangles spring-loaded.

beats.strategy: Opa puts on a hat to hide the hair and stop brushing.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hat is sucked into the hair-knot and swallowed, disappearing into the tangled mass.
beats.newInformation: The hair's tangling now acts like a living trap, consuming objects.

beats.strategy: Opa uses scissors to cut the hair away.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hair regrows instantly into a larger, tighter knot, trapping the scissors.
beats.newInformation: Cutting triggers accelerated regrowth with more tangles.

raw.finalPayoff: The hair regrows instantly into a larger, tighter knot, trapping the scissors.
raw.loopPotential: Opa can try different tools, but the hair always re-tangles and often captures the tool.
raw.providerRationale: Brush's detangling function reversed into knot-creation is visually clear; regrowth adds escalation.
